stories.headline: G20 Nations Commit to Ambitious Renewable Energy Targets
stories.summary: G20 leaders reached a landmark agreement to triple renewable energy capacity by 2030, a critical step in combating climate change.

stories.headline: Powerful Earthquake Strikes Southeast Asia; Rescue Efforts Underway
stories.summary: A magnitude 7.5 earthquake hit a densely populated region in Southeast Asia, causing widespread damage and significant loss of life.

stories.headline: EU Passes Landmark AI Liability Law, Setting Global Precedent
stories.summary: The European Union approved new regulations holding AI developers accountable for system errors, influencing global tech governance.

stories.headline: WHO Reports Major Progress in African Malaria Vaccine Rollout
stories.summary: The World Health Organization announced successful expansion of the new malaria vaccine across several African nations, drastically reducing infections.

stories.headline: US Federal Reserve Hints at Rate Hike Amid Persistent Inflation
stories.summary: The Federal Reserve indicated a potential interest rate increase in its next meeting, responding to stubbornly high inflation figures.
